param_input_item.param_description: Hours, minutes, seconds, optional milliseconds, duration text, or an N-by-3 numeric matrix.

param_output_item.param_description: A duration array storing elapsed seconds and a display format.

description.p: The constructor accepts numeric parts and common colon-separated text forms. Use hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds, days, and years for unit-specific construction and conversion.

string returns the display text of each element and <missing> for a NaN duration; the display, char and cellstr keep the text NaN (cellstr(d, fmt) uses the format fmt). duration(missing), and assigning missing into a duration array, give NaN.
duration.empty(m, n, ...) returns an empty duration array. A comparison with missing is false (~= is true), as with a NaN duration.
Array-valued inputs keep their data shape when the operation supports arrays. Scalar operands are expanded where the implementation defines scalar expansion.

example_item.example_item_data: d = duration(1, 2, 3) seconds(d) duration('1:02', 'InputFormat', 'mm:ss') string(seconds([1 NaN]))
